text:
Nadine: Hi team 1 I submitted my resignation today. Last day will be 2026-07-10. Two quick asks: confirm benefits/COBRA timing and request a 24-48h alumni access window after last day so I can finish a recorded handoff with the new owner.

Omar: Thanks for the heads-up, Nadine. Benefits remain active through 2026-07-10 23:59 PT. COBRA notice is emailed within ~10 business days; you then have 60 days to enroll. We can request a short alumni access window (48h) for documentation only 1 please confirm exact times you need. Also will kick off the offboard checklist and final paycheck timing.

Nadine: Ideally keep access until 2026-07-11 18:00 PT so I can record the KT and finish migrating a small eval bucket. Ill leave clear rotation steps in Confluence.

Jin: IT here 1 we can allow a 48-hour extension for Slack/SSO and building access by exception, but API keys and service tokens must be rotated before extension unless they're marked for handoff. Please run this quick inventory and paste results: 

```
redwood-cli auth list --owner nadine --json
```

Nadine: Running now, results pasted to Confluence (link in runbook). I have two service tokens: eval-runner and data-sync. I'll add rotation steps.

Jin: Noted. We'll schedule eval-runner rotation for 2026-07-11 13:00 PT and keep data-sync active until 2026-07-11 18:00 PT to match your request. Keycard revocation default is 09:00 PT next day; we'll keep it active through your requested window.

People Ops Bot: COBRA notice queued to nadine@redwood.com within 10 business days. COBRA enrollment window: 60 days from notice date. Benefits termination: 2026-07-10 23:59 PT. Offboard doc: https://hr.redwood.com/offboard/3192026000.

Omar: Exit interview options: 2026-07-15 or 2026-07-17 which do you prefer? We'll also send the separation survey after the interview. Final paycheck and accrued PTO payment will be processed on the next payroll run (date included in offboard doc).

Nadine: Prefer 7/15 morning. Thanks for accommodating the short extension and token rotation timing. I'll upload the recorded KT to the runbook and leave a 1-page priority list. Appreciate it.

Jin: If anything changes with tokens or service accounts, ping this thread so we don't accidentally break the pipeline during rotation.

Omar: Got it. Offboard task created and calendar invites sent. We'll follow up in DM for any private items. :white_check_mark:
